nina-partners: Quick idea 1: private-offer structure for marketplace + appliance bundling: 1yr commit with a 3-mo convert-or-lose onramp credit, plus a staged renewal ladder (volume bands give incremental discount at renew). Goal: make quoting simple for SIs and avoid big upfront discounts. thoughts?

gabe-sales: Like it. Proposal: bands = 0-99k(2%),100-299k(8%),300k+(16%). Onramp credit = up to 30% of month1 consumption (cap $15k). Convert if usage >=85% at month9.

tara-legal: Legal notes: define "convert" precisely, include clawback if customer terminates within 120d after credit applied. Also must exclude public-sector/appliance-airgapped from marketplace offers.

ugo-ops: Billing implications: need credit token type + partner attribution tag. Estimate 2 sprints to add tag and token; partner payout flow another sprint.

ashwin-si: SI ask: allow a 6% success fee for full-deploy within 60 days; proof = acceptance sign-off + meter spike. Without SI incentive SIs deprioritize.

nina-partners: ok add SI success fee but paid as partner payout after 90d. We'll require deployment proof and usage threshold for payment.

marketbot: Drafted offer snippet:
OFFER_SNIP: TERM=12m; BANDS=[0-99k:2%,100-299k:8%,300k+:16%]; ONRAMP=max(30% month1, cap 15k); SI_FEE=6% payout after 90d with proof; CONVERT_CRIT=usage>=85% by month9

gabe-sales: Next steps: 1) legal to draft clause, 2) ops to estimate ETA, 3) pick pilot SI & market. I'll own pilot selection.

tara-legal: I'll send a 1-pg clause today.

ugo-ops: ETA: 3 sprints to instrument everything if prioritized.

ashwin-si: Happy to pilot in APAC.

nina-partners: I'll collate and post a 1-slide pilot playbook. Pinning this as canonical thread.

marketbot: Thread pinned in #partnerships by nina-partners.
